cache_policy: One excluded in-process warmup; each repetition constructs a fresh problem, registries, provider selections, prepared strategy and exclusive workspace. Process/runtime may be warm; no cold-cache claim.
load_note: All processor CPU percentage samples were taken immediately before and after the accepted process, outside accepted timing; no competing benchmark side and no dedicated quiet machine guarantee.
native_provider_thread_configuration: The public profile invokes the registered HiGHS LP provider during terminal optimization. ResourcePolicy requests one thread; actual native provider thread count is unavailable
seed: No seed option is exposed/configured by this StrategyPort/HiGHS registration path
